seo.title: Waymark — An AI companion that stays beside you at every decision
seo.description: The bigger the decision, the more you need someone beside you — not someone to decide for you. Waymark remembers your decisions, reaches out when you waver, and brings stories from people who walked the same path. Coming soon.

hero.sub:
So that you, standing before decisions big and small, are never alone in the moment.
At every fork, beside you.
hero.chip: Soon, beside your decisions — arriving before long

empathy.title: The bigger the decision, the rarer it is to have someone beside you — not someone with the answer.
empathy.p1: We all make countless decisions every day — from today's small choices to the forks that change our direction. Yet in the heaviest moments, advice is everywhere while someone to carry the weight with you is rare.
empathy.p2: Waymark isn't a tool that decides for you. It's a companion that remembers the decisions you've made, reaches out first when you waver, and offers the story of someone who walked the same road.

loop.title: Four beats that never leave you alone
loop.desc: A decision doesn't end in a single moment. From capture to reflection, Waymark walks the whole arc of a decision with you.

steps.d: Record the moment you decided — and how you felt.
When you waver, Waymark speaks to you first.
A story arrives from someone who faced the same fork.
In time, you meet that decision again.

modes.title: Four tones, one posture
modes.desc: It comes to you in the tone the moment calls for — comfort when you need comfort, clarity when you need clarity.

demo.entry: Got an offer. Better pay, but I'd be putting down the work I do.
demo.gap: Three days later, Waymark speaks first

turns.msg: You're not failing to decide. You're weighing it.
What's costly to let go — the work, or what you've built around it?

items.d: On days a decision feels heavy, it steadies your heart first.
It doesn't hand you an answer; it traces the branches of your thinking with you.
It adds the strength to carry the decision you've made forward.
It distills tangled thoughts into a shape you can decide on.

modes.reassure: The decision is always yours. Waymark never decides for you — it only lights the fork and keeps you company.

landing.featuresTitle: Built for Mac: no silent freezes, no capture failures
landing.featuresSub: How audio gets gathered, how it gets understood, and what it leaves behind — we rebuilt all three.
landing.f1Desc: Prevents audio device loss caused by detaching bluetooth earphones during meetings. It dynamically detects your AirPods' real name and maps it automatically to the audio stream, gracefully falling back to the built-in mic if the connection drops.
landing.f2Desc: Powered primarily by local on-device neural networks, with an automatic fallback to Apple's secure server speech recognition when local language packs are unavailable, ensuring continuous and precise transcription.
landing.f3Desc: Uses the next-gen ScreenCaptureKit API to cleanly separate three audio sources — built-in mic, AirPods (Bluetooth), and system sound — without mixing. Captures Zoom, Teams, and YouTube audio losslessly; system-sound capture uses the macOS screen-recording permission.
landing.f4Desc: Your personal API Key is stored encrypted in the macOS Secure Keychain. AI processing never passes through our servers — data goes straight from your device to your chosen provider such as Google Gemini (2.5 Flash/Pro). Real-time subtitles send text only; Enhanced Minutes upload the recorded audio via your own key.
landing.f5Desc: The moment a session ends, Sylphio shows a modern minutes view and generates a local Markdown (.md) report with Action Items and an executive summary. Choose between real-time interpretation mode and a minutes-only mode that transcribes and summarizes without translation.
landing.f6Desc: Features a unified 720x700 spacious layout and dynamic subtitle font scaling controlled via an intuitive slider, offering optimal readability and native macOS experience.
landing.f7Desc: After a session ends, your recorded audio (.m4a) is re-analyzed by Google Gemini's multimodal model for far more accurate transcription and summary (plus translation in interpretation mode). Sessions that switched audio sources are merged into one for full analysis and download, and you can 'Regenerate' later once quota recovers. (BYOK Pro · audio is uploaded to Google via your own key.)

landing.simSub: Get a sneak peek at how the real Sylphio app captures and translates dialogue in real-time through this web simulator.

guide.byokTitle: Advantages of BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) Architecture
guide.byokDesc: Sylphio uses a secure BYOK approach where you enter your own API Key. All AI processing bypasses developer servers entirely and flows directly between your device and the AI provider's secure endpoint; saved keys are kept encrypted in macOS's Secure Keychain. Real-time summary sends the transcribed text, and when you use 'Enhanced Minutes' the recorded audio file (.m4a) is uploaded directly to your chosen provider (e.g., Google Gemini) via your own key for transcription and summary.
guide.geminiTitle: 1. Google Gemini API Key Issuance Process (Recommended / Free)
guide.geminiIntro: Google Gemini delivers exceptional comprehension and translation accuracy, combined with an incredibly generous Free Tier that lowers the barrier to using Sylphio to zero.
guide.geminiStep2: Click the Get API key button in the top left sidebar menu.
guide.geminiStep3: Click Create API key in the center, and choose Create API key in new project in the popup to generate your key.
guide.geminiStep4: Instantly copy the unique key string (starting with AIzaSy...) using the provided button and save it securely.
guide.geminiFreeDesc:
Cost: 100% Free
Limits: The free tier applies per-model requests-per-minute (RPM) plus a daily request cap (roughly a few dozen requests per day).
Real-time subtitle translation runs on free Google Translate / on-device engines so it never consumes your API Key quota. Your key is used (1) to generate the real-time minutes summary after a session, and (2) when you run 'Enhanced Minutes' (recording re-analysis). Enhanced Minutes uploads audio, which is a large call — repeating it many times a day on the free tier may hit the daily cap. If that happens, simply 'Regenerate' once your quota resets.
guide.geminiPayDesc: If you desire limitless high-speed translation, you can opt to register billing. The cost is incredibly low at approximately $0.075 per 1 million input tokens (around 100 KRW).
guide.openaiTitle: 2. OpenAI API Key Issuance Process (Pro & High-Performance)
guide.openaiIntro: OpenAI's GPT-4o-mini engine ensures brilliant language switching accuracy, swift response times, and exceptional conversation summary capabilities.
guide.openaiWarningDesc: Unlike Google, OpenAI keys will return a quota error immediately if your account balance is $0, even if the key itself is successfully generated. You must pre-charge at least $5 to activate API operations.
guide.openaiStep2: Select the key-shaped API keys menu in the left navigation bar.
guide.openaiStep3: Click + Create new secret key in the top right, name the key, and generate it.
guide.openaiStep4: Copy the sk-proj-... secret key immediately. (It cannot be viewed again once you close the popup.)
guide.openaiStep5: Navigate to Settings > Billing on the left menu, click Add to balance, and pre-charge at least $5.
guide.openaiPriceDesc:
- Input cost: $0.150 / 1M tokens
- Output cost: $0.600 / 1M tokens
- Real-time subtitle translation is powered by local/free engines and incurs no cost. Your OpenAI key is called after a session to generate the text summary, costing well under a cent per session.
- Note: 'Enhanced Minutes' (audio re-analysis) uses Google Gemini's multimodal model only; your OpenAI key is used for text summaries.
guide.appSetupTitle: 3. How to Integrate API Key Inside Sylphio App
guide.appStep2: Click the Settings gear icon (⚙️) in the top-right of the standby screen.
guide.appStep3: Select the AI Engine (BYOK) tab in the left-side settings menu.
guide.appStep4: Turn the Activate AI PRO Real-Time Translation Switch to ON.
guide.appStep5: Choose your preferred AI platform (Google Gemini or OpenAI).
guide.appStep6: Paste (CMD + V) your copied API Key string into the field.
guide.appStep7: Verify the key activation display. Once done, close settings to unlock the AI Executive summary and multi-language auto-detection features immediately!
guide.faq1Q: Q1. It keeps showing "Activate AI Translation in Settings ⚙️" or "Translation Error."
guide.faq1A:
- Cause: Unwanted whitespace, trailing newlines (\n), or an invalid character is mixed into your API Key input.
- Solution: Completely clear the input box, paste your key into a plain text editor to make sure there are no spaces, and copy-paste it cleanly again.
guide.faq2Q: Q2. I connected my OpenAI key, but it keeps returning a "Quota Exceeded" error.
guide.faq2A:
- Cause: Your OpenAI API account balance is $0, or your registered card billing information has expired, causing a temporary account hold.
- Solution: Go to platform.openai.com, check your balance, and pre-charge a minimum of $5 to restore service.

privacy.intro: PriSincera ('we', 'us', or 'our') operates the Sylphio Mac application (the 'Service'). We are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains our 'Zero Data Collection' principle.

sections.title: 1. Zero Data Collection
sections.content: Sylphio is a utility application designed with privacy at its core. We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal data, audio recordings, or transcribed texts to our own servers.

sections.title: 2. Audio & Speech Processing
bullets: Local Mode (Apple Frameworks): If you use the built-in translation, all audio capture and speech-to-text processing occurs via Apple's native framework (SFSpeechRecognizer). Audio data is processed safely and anonymously on-device or via Apple's secure servers in accordance with Apple's secure speech recognition policy, and the developer (PriSincera) does not collect any data.

Pro Mode (BYOK - Bring Your Own Key): If you provide your own API Key (e.g., Google Gemini, OpenAI), (1) real-time subtitle translation sends only the recognized text to the AI provider, and (2) when you run the 'Enhanced Minutes' feature, the recorded audio file (.m4a) itself is uploaded directly from your device to the chosen provider (e.g., Google Gemini) after the session for transcription and summary. All transmissions are direct device-to-provider communication that never passes through PriSincera servers, and whether/when data is sent depends entirely on which features you choose to use. PriSincera does not intercept or store your data and operates no server capable of accessing it.

Meeting audio recording & local storage: To power subtitles, minutes, and Enhanced Minutes, audio is recorded and saved on your device as an .m4a (AAC) file during a session. Recording starts only after your explicit consent (a pre-recording consent modal) and shows a '● Recording' indicator while active; files are stored inside the app's sandbox container. You can delete any recording anytime from 'History', and system-sound capture uses the macOS screen-recording permission (ScreenCaptureKit). These recordings remain solely on your device and are never transmitted unless you run Enhanced Minutes.

sections.title: 3. API Key Security
sections.content: Your personal API Keys are strictly stored locally on your device using Apple's encrypted Keychain. We do not sync, upload, or have access to your API Keys.

sections.title: 4. Third-Party Analytics
sections.content: We do not embed any third-party tracking or analytics SDKs (like Google Analytics or Mixpanel) in the app. We solely rely on the anonymous crash reports and opt-in app usage data provided by Apple's standard App Store Analytics.
